subtopic: Guaranteed Minimum Income and Accumulation Benefits
source_evidence: These benefits provide that your contract value will be at least equal to a stated minimum amount after a specified number of years, regardless of market performance.
question: Misconception: A guaranteed minimum accumulation benefit means your contract value can never fall below the promised minimum at any time.
answer: The guarantee applies after a specified number of years, not necessarily at every point during the contract. The benefit promises that the contract value will be at least the stated minimum at the specified time, regardless of market performance.
